headline: Indonesia Refuses to Export Electricity to Singapore Without Fair Pricing
summary: Indonesia stated it will not export electricity to Singapore unless the two countries agree on a suitable price, casting doubt on plans to supply up to 3.4 gigawatts of low-carbon power.
why: Cross-border energy trade negotiations involve complex pricing structures and sovereign resource valuation between regional trading partners.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Stalling cross-border electricity sales prevents commercialization of large-scale green energy supply projects.
